name: keynote-light
about: Apple's light keynote board (WWDC 2025 iPadOS and iOS summary slides): white tiles on #ebeceb, near-black labels, statements in Apple's teal-to-blue gradient, app icons with a soft shadow. Colours sampled from the slides. Uses the system font stack, so on a Mac it renders in SF Pro; SF Pro is never embedded (Apple's licence forbids redistribution).
